description: American Cultures explores the many backgrounds that make up the United States — including your own — through festivals, places, conversations, stories and history, and asks how different groups can understand one another better.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Experiencing other cultures
requirements.summary: Options for learning about three groups first-hand, such as attending an event, visiting a place of worship or institution, or talking with members of a group.

requirements.title: Groups living together
requirements.summary: Imagining each group living on its own and then all three living together.

requirements.title: Customs compared
requirements.summary: Differences and similarities among the groups’ religious and social customs.

requirements.title: Contributions
requirements.summary: Contributions made to the country by people from different backgrounds.

requirements.title: Leading a discussion
requirements.summary: A talk about how different groups have gotten along, and leading a discussion on building understanding.
